title: Document profile registry
description: Validates the single Stage 99 path, profile, frontmatter, section, lifecycle, relationship, and template-binding authority.

shared_contract.description: Identifies reviewed common input and the local adapter; structural validity does not authenticate approval or adoption.

common_forms.description: The opt-in section tree per document role; a role has a form only once it is listed.

frontmatter_keys.description: One entry per frontmatter key a profile requires, allows, forbids or orders (SPEC-0181).

frontmatter_dialect.description: The YAML and JSON Schema dialect of frontmatter, as it is and as it is meant to be (SPEC-0181).

work_residue.description: The Task table that carries live work residue rows and the legacy Task tables exempt from the residue check (SPEC-0191). The ledger and schema paths are constants of the work-residue-ledger gate.

relationship_contract.description: The relation kinds, document relations and link types with their direction, cardinality, owner, consumers, checks and tests (SPEC-0193).

policy_rule_ids.description: The policy rule ID grammar, the levels, the reserved codes, the condition and minimum of the Rules table and one registered code per policy (SPEC-0194).

section.description: One section of a form in the COMMON-DOC-FORM-1 list, which also holds Stage 99 local forms; link_only is the one local field.

template_definition.description: The eleven TemplateDefinition fields a registry stores; the other eight (template_id, role, metadata, headings, relationships, lifecycle, language and extensions) are derived by template_definition_record and validated against template-definition.schema.json. headings_extension, stored only on a role without a form, feeds the derived extensions field.

contract_version.description: A contract identifier, a slash and a SemVer value: COMMON-DOC-FORM-1 and the common_forms version for a COMMON-DOC-FORM-1 role, STAGE99-LOCAL-FORM-1/1.0.0 for a Stage 99 local role. REGISTRY_TEMPLATE_RECORD owns the grammar.

headings_extension.description: Only on a role without a form (provider-native): the conditional extension that records its empty headings, with an id, condition, owner, verification, review and removal. REGISTRY_TEMPLATE_EXTENSION owns its shape.

template_table.description: One table a template carries: its section, ordered columns, minimum data rows and row identity.

section.description: A section ID or local H3 extension ID of the role's form; a role without a form records no table.

frontmatter_key.description: One description per frontmatter key; key set and value grammar stay with the profiles and frontmatter.schema.json.

relation.description: One document relation with its direction, cardinality, owner, consumers, checks and tests (SPEC-0193).

link_type.description: One link type with its meaning, direction, requiredness, authority, pinning, checks and tests (SPEC-0193).
